mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_Volunteer ( Username, Password, Name, PhoneNumber, IDCardNumber, Country, Gender, Ethnicity, PoliticalStatus, HighestEducation, EmploymentStatus, ServiceCategory, ServiceArea ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{password}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{idCard}, #{country}, #{gender}, #{ethnicity}, #{politicalStatus}, #{highestEducation}, #{employmentStatus}, #{serviceCategory}, #{serviceArea} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_Volunteer SET VolunteerID = #{volunteerId}, Username = #{username}, Name = #{name}, PhoneNumber = #{phone}, IDCardNumber = #{idCard}, Country = #{country}, Gender = #{gender}, Ethnicity = #{ethnicity}, PoliticalStatus = #{politicalStatus}, HighestEducation = #{highestEducation}, EmploymentStatus = #{employmentStatus}, ServiceCategory = #{serviceCategory}, ServiceArea = #{serviceArea} WHERE VolunteerID = #{volunteerId}
